title: Jewish Holidays Calendar API (Hebcal-style) input
description: Generate the full Jewish/Hebrew calendar for one year: holidays, fasts, Rosh Chodesh, Omer, parasha, Israel or diaspora schedule.

year.title: Year
year.description: The Gregorian (or, if yearType is "hebrew", Hebrew) year to generate the calendar for.

yearType.title: Year type
yearType.description: Whether "year" is a Gregorian calendar year (spans two Hebrew years) or a single Hebrew year.

location.title: Location
location.description: Israel observes one day for holidays the diaspora observes for two (e.g. Sukkot II is Chol HaMoed in Israel but a full Yom Tov in the diaspora), and has extra modern civil holidays (Yom HaAtzma'ut, Yom HaZikaron, ...).

include.title: Categories to include
include.description: Which categories of day to return. Default is major holidays and fasts only; add "minor", "roshChodesh", "modern", "omer", "parasha" or "specialShabbat" for more (e.g. Chanukah and Purim are "minor").

language.title: Output language
language.description: Which language fields to fill in each result: English, Hebrew, or both.

format.title: Output format
format.description: Dataset rows are always JSON. "csv" or "ics" additionally writes that file to the run's key-value store (record "OUTPUT") for direct download/import into a calendar app.
